Or stage some natural disaster? That'd motivate them to leave the place on their own accord.''"
"''We've actually gamed that out. It gets unpredictable very quickly.|Daysar and Moy|audio=WhyNotHaveAPlague-OneYearLater.flac|}} '''Daysar''' was a [[human]] [[Imperial Navy's officer corps|Imperial officer]] with the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 BBY]], Daysar was one of a handful of Imperials personally requested by [[Director of Advanced Weapons Research]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] to join the [[Ghorman project]], which Daysar agreed to join. As a member of the project, the admiral attended a [[Maltheen Divide conference|secret conference]] at the [[Maltheen Divide]] alongside members of other Imperial organizations involved in the project. During the conference, they discussed the project's need to extract the vital [[mineral]] [[kalkite]] from the surface of the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] for use in the [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]'s "[[Project Celestial Power|energy project]]." Daysar questioned various attendees on aspects of the Ghorman project, such as repopulation efforts, and later suggested creating a plague or feigning a natural disaster to relocate the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman people]], before [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Moy]] shared that simulations had been run that had gamed those ideas out. ==Biography== ===Admiral of the Ghorman project=== {{Quote|No notes. No records. None of you were here. Nobody puts this in their calendar. All service and transport droids will be data-wiped, once we're done. Your colleagues, superiors… if they're not in this room, they're not cleared for the project. Colonel Yularen, Governor Tarkin, all senior commanders will be notified by the Emperor, at the time of his choosing. Now, the group in this room is, of this moment, the tightest of closed circles. Any security violation will be brought to the Emperor's personal attention.|Orson Krennic instructs discretion to Daysar and the other attendees at the Maltheen Divide conference|audio=SecretProject-OYL.mp3|}} [[File:DaysarandPartagazatMaltheenDivideconference.png|thumb|left|300px|Admiral Daysar attended the Maltheen Divide conference hosted by Director Krennic]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Daysar served in the [[Imperial Military]]'s [[Imperial Navy|naval branch]], reaching the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[admiral]]. By [[4 BBY]], they were one of a handful of [[Imperial officer]]s who worked with [[Director of Advanced Weapons Research|Director]] [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]] on the [[Ghorman project]], an initiative by Krennic to increase Imperial control over the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] in order to extract the vital [[mineral]] [[kalkite]] from the surface. The kalkite was required for the [[Project Stardust|construction]] of Krennic's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]], which was being fronted as [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]'s "[[Project Celestial Power|energy project]]" for the time being.{{Andor|Make It Stop}} The [[mining]] of the kalkite was feared to destabilize the planet's core, and, as such, the planet's [[Ghorman (people)|population]] needed to be handled in methods created by the project. That same year, Daysar, along with other members of the Ghorman project, was summoned by Krennic to a [[Maltheen Divide conference|secret conference]] in the [[Maltheen Divide]] to discuss next steps for the removal of the Ghormans. There, the director explained the meeting's secrecy; there would be no records or notes, and any violation of security within the group would be brought to Palpatine's personal attention. Krennic then played to the room a [[Unidentified Ghorman holodocumentary|Ghorman Holodocumentary]] that detailed information about the planet, such as its [[Ghorman twill]] industry. Soon after, Krennic revealed the Empire's need for the planet's kalkite. ===Discussion and dessert=== {{Quote|There is a risk of… total collapse.''"
"''Nine cities. Eight-hundred thousand Ghormans.''"
"''Well, relocation would be ideal. But we need to plan for alternatives, all of which will require preparation.|Krennic and Daysar exchange information during the Maltheen Divide conference|audio=ThereIsARiskOfTotalCollapse-OneYearLater.flac|}} Discussion at the conference soon ensued on the [[suppression of Ghorman]] through the use of military and [[Anti-Ghorman whispering campaign|propaganda]]. When [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB) [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]] questioned the process of the kalkite extraction, an [[Unidentified engineer officer|engineering officer]] stated that the process would provide major challenges to the local population. Daysar, unsatisfied with the lack of detail, requested clarity, to which the engineering officer responded by sharing how the [[Gouge mining|mining process]] could stress the planet's core, potentially destabilizing the planet. Following these comments, Daysar, unsure of what was to happen to the planet's population, reminded the room of statistics relating to the planet's population and cities, to which Krennic responded by sharing the possibility of repopulation, though added that the group should prepare for "alternative solutions." [[File:DaysarquestionsMoy.png|thumb|right|300px|Admiral Daysar suggested various relocation tactics to lieutenant Moy.]] As the conference continued, snacks were brought into the room for attendees, allowing the various Imperial [[officer]]s to converse privately. During this time, the admiral took some treats for themself while suggesting various relocation tactics, such as staged plagues or staged natural disasters, to ISB [[Lieutenant]] [[Moy]], who then shared how various simulations had gamed out such possibilities. Ultimately, [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] was put in charge of the Ghorman project, and the suppression of Ghorman began.{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} ==Personality and traits== {{Dialogue|Partagaz|The Kalkite extraction; I'm assuming it's an invasive process?|Engineering officer|It would present stark challenges to the local population.|Daysar|Meaning what?|Engineering officer|The extent of our withdrawal may render the planet unstable. It's gouge mining. There would be stress on the planet's core.|attr=Members of the Ghorman project, including Daysar, discuss the destructive process of Gouge mining and its potential effects on Ghorman|audio=TheKalkiteExtraction-ItsAnInvasiveProcesss-OneYearLater.flac|src=}} Daysar kept focus during meetings, paying attention to the important details and asking for further clarity when details were not provided. A [[human]], Daysar had light skin, [[Color|white]] [[hair]], and blue [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Daysar wore a dark gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with a [[code cylinder]] on each [[breast]] and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with six blue tiles. ==Behind the scenes== Daysar debuted in "[[One Year Later]]," the premiere episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]]. Daysar was portrayed by actor [[David Westhead]], and while not referred to by name in the episode, the character was identified as "Admiral Daysar" in the credits. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|One Year Later}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|f6UQ_lPBUhU|Andor Season 2 | The Tightest of Closed Circles | Now Streaming on Disney+}} *{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Daysar|soundcat=Audio files of Daysar}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Daysar |ja=デイサー |ka=დეისარი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy admirals of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
